panels.title: Market read
panels.limitation: Completed sessions only; the badge counts four checks.
panels.source: Desk roster daily bars, Cboe VIX

panels.title: Sector strength
panels.limitation: Relative strength against SPY over 20 sessions.

panels.title: Market strip
panels.limitation: Open interest does not say who holds it.

panels.title: Market Pulse
panels.limitation: SPY, QQQ, IWM and SMH, regular hours; gaps over 15 minutes break the line.

panels.title: Sectors today
panels.limitation: Eleven sector funds against the prior close.

panels.title: Movers
panels.limitation: Roster names priced at $5 or more, latest completed session.

panels.title: Market Mood
panels.limitation: Percentiles of each gauge's own history; no band under 250 observations.

panels.title: Move and regime
panels.limitation: Measured on completed sessions.

panels.title: Indexes
panels.limitation: SPY and QQQ daily.

panels.title: Mood Ring
panels.limitation: Cboe daily closes.

panels.title: Pulse states
panels.limitation: Breadth states by session.

panels.title: Breadth
panels.limitation: Waits until 90% of the roster reports.

panels.title: Risk appetite
panels.limitation: Fund ratios.

panels.title: Heatmap
panels.limitation: Funds with 64 sessions of history.

panels.title: Rotation
panels.limitation: Against SPY.

panels.title: Morning Map
panels.limitation: Modelled positioning, never observed.

panels.title: Qualified Board
panels.limitation: Research only, no orders.

panels.title: Golden Sweep Wire
panels.limitation: Prints, not intent.
panels.why: no data: no print met the rule on the watched underlyings

panels.title: Gamma Ladder
panels.limitation: Modelled dealer gamma, not observed; strikes within 5% of spot.

panels.title: Expiry Pin Watch
panels.limitation: Open interest at the prior close; six nearest expiries.

panels.title: Insider Wire
panels.limitation: Open-market buys by three or more insiders within 30 days.

panels.title: News
panels.limitation: Headline direction by fixed word lists, not a reading of the article.
panels.why: the news lane has not run yet

panels.title: Calendar
panels.limitation: Scheduled releases only (FOMC, CPI, payrolls); early closes end at 1 PM ET.
panels.source: NYSE session calendar; Federal Reserve and BLS schedules

panels.title: News ticker
panels.limitation: A name in the headline itself is marked named; otherwise the feed tagged it.
panels.why: the news lane has not run yet

panels.title: My Book
panels.limitation: Simulated fills at Alpaca SIP 5-minute opens and option quotes; no order is placed.

panels.title: Forecasts
panels.limitation: Probabilities read as scores until an engine's calibration is attested.

panels.title: The desk
panels.limitation: Paper account.
panels.why: Its last reading is older than its freshness rule allows; the value is not shown as current.

panels.title: Engine
panels.limitation: Hidden when its read is stale.
